raw_response:
I'll think through this as the farmer and then give the plan.

---

My reasoning:

I am 69 years old, I have worked this land for 50 years. My 5 mu is split up — I grow different vegetables in different plots because my family eats some and I sell the rest at the market in town. My wife helps me, but two of my sons work in the city, so on busy days I hire a neighbor for a few hours.

The cropping system on most of the land is cabbage in spring, chili through summer into autumn, then cabbage again for winter — but on this 5 mu I also set aside strips for cucumber, eggplant, and kidney bean because the family likes them and they sell well in summer. So I divide roughly: chili about 2 mu (main cash crop), cucumber 1 mu, eggplant 1 mu, kidney bean 1 mu.

**Fertilizer.** I did not go past primary school, but I have used compound fertilizer for many years. Before planting I spread chicken manure from the village — about one cart per mu — then I put down 2 bags of 15-15-15 compound, that is about 80 kg. Later when the plants are growing strong I top-dress with urea, maybe 30 kg per mu, sometimes twice for chili because it keeps fruiting. My neighbor Old Liu last year put less urea and his peppers were yellow and small, so I would rather put a bit extra. Wasting a few yuan of fertilizer is nothing compared to thin peppers at harvest. Kidney bean is a legume, it makes its own nitrogen, I put less urea on it.

**Water.** I have a well, so I irrigate when the soil is dry and when the plants are flowering and fruiting. Chili and cucumber need a lot of water — I water maybe 10 times. Eggplant similar. Kidney bean less, maybe 6-7 times, too much water and the roots rot.

**Pesticide.** Aphids and thrips hit the chili and eggplant every year. I spray when I see them, usually 7-8 times through the season. Cucumber gets downy mildew when it is humid, I spray maybe 6 times. Kidney bean fewer problems, 4-5 times.

**Seeds.** I buy improved seeds from the town dealer — the old village seed is not as good, I learned that ten years ago. For chili I use the long red kind everyone here grows because the buyers want it.

**Tillage.** I pay the tractor man to rotary-till before planting, 40 yuan per mu. That is what everyone does.

**Yield.** If the weather is not too dry and pests are not bad, I expect about 2500 kg chili, 5000 kg cucumber, 4500 kg eggplant, 2000 kg kidney bean per mu. Some years less, some years more.
